interface.signature: def findKthNumber(n: int, k: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: Both n and k must be integers.
k and n must satisfy 1 <= k <= n <= 10^9.

postconditions.description: The returned value must be within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: len([x for x in range(1, n + 1) if str(x) < str(return_value)]) == k - 1
postconditions.description: The returned value is the k-th smallest integer in lexicographical order among integers from 1 to n, meaning exactly k-1 integers in the range are lexicographically smaller than it.
